faqSubtitle: Common questions regarding BIS licensing, compliance, and mark verification
faq1Q: What is the difference between ISI Mark and CRS Registration?
faq1A: The ISI Mark (Scheme-I) requires factory quality system audits, continuous surveillance, and testing before a CM/L license is issued. The Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS Scheme-II) is based on self-declaration of conformity supported by test reports from BIS-recognized labs without mandatory pre-grant factory inspections.
faq2Q: Are Quality Control Orders (QCOs) compulsory for imported products?
faq2A: Yes. Once a QCO is notified under Section 16 of the BIS Act 2016, no foreign or domestic manufacturer can export, manufacture, or sell the specified goods in India without a valid BIS license or registration.
faq3Q: How can I verify if a gold jewellery item is genuine?
faq3A: Look for three symbols on the piece: the BIS logo, the purity grade (e.g. 22K916), and the 6-character alphanumeric HUID. Verify the HUID on the official BIS CARE mobile app using the 'Verify HUID' feature.
